info.name: Co-working Space Reservation API
info.description:
Demo and regression collection for the jubjub Co-working Space Reservation API (2110503 SW Dev Practice, Project #6).

Run order = presentation order. Needs `npm run seed` once (for admin@seed.test / 123456); it then runs green again without reseeding.
Reservation dates are computed in the collection pre-request script relative to now, in Thai time (+07:00): `{{today}}`, `{{yesterday}}`, `{{day1}}` … `{{day30}}`.
Every response must arrive within 3000 ms (collection-level test).
A run sends about 60 requests; set RATE_LIMIT_MAX higher (e.g. 500) in config/config.env when running it more than once in 10 minutes.

item.name: Reset password (manual: paste token from server console)

request.description:
MANUAL – excluded from the Runner / Newman order.

1. Send "10. Extra – password reset / Forgot password for a registered email" (or POST /auth/forgotpassword with any registered email).
2. With SMTP_HOST empty, the server console prints the email; copy the token at the end of the link `/resetpassword/<token>`.
3. Set the collection variable `resetToken` to that token and send this request.
4. Log in with the new password `newpass123`. Sending this request again gives 400: the token works only once (and expires after 15 minutes).
